method: Owner-maintained milestone estimates; nightly workflow records these estimates alongside live repository evidence. The workflow does not infer that a commit alone completes a capability.

phases.name: Security, tenancy and platform foundation
phases.evidence_note: Central identity, tenant isolation, authorization, MFA and security foundations substantially implemented; final reconciliation and production evidence remain.

phases.name: Public platform and enterprise foundations
phases.evidence_note: Public site, moderation, notifications and several domain foundations exist; App Shell build and responsive contract verification now pass on main; end-to-end integration and production validation remain.

phases.name: Business domain workflows
phases.evidence_note: Finance, Shareholder, People, Organization, Governance, Documents, Communication and Calendar are at mixed maturity; targeted Communication announcement tests pass on the latest tested head, while full domain acceptance and Calendar exact-head verification remain in progress.

phases.name: Unified integration and experience
phases.evidence_note: Cross-domain workflows, frontend/API contract consistency and unified navigation remain in progress.

phases.name: Intelligence, automation and analytics
phases.evidence_note: Strategic direction is established; advanced AI, predictive analytics and workflow intelligence are early-stage.

phases.name: Production readiness and operations
phases.evidence_note: Deployment, monitoring, recovery, performance, security certification and operational readiness remain substantial gaps.

benchmarks.comparison: Broad integrated accounting, inventory, sales, HR and business application coverage; ARNA is earlier in functional completeness.
Mature accounting, HR, projects and inventory workflows; ARNA's opportunity is Ethiopian-context and governance integration.
Enterprise-scale finance, controls and operations; ARNA is not yet comparable in controls, scale or operational proof.
Broad finance, operations, CRM and analytics; ARNA's cross-domain vision is comparable in direction, not maturity.
Useful benchmark for extensibility, lifecycle automation and analytics; not a direct functional equivalent to ARNA.
Mature collaboration, communication, documents and calendars; ARNA's opportunity is linking these activities to governed enterprise records.

evidence_observations.area: ARNA App Shell and frontend verification
evidence_observations.finding: All 68 failures in the sampled 100-run window were Frontend verification runs on feat/arna-app-shell-phase-2 (32 pull_request and 36 push events). The failing notification assertions used over-escaped regular-expression patterns; the assertions were changed to stable string-presence checks. The merged main head passed the complete frontend workflow.
evidence_observations.reason_no_percentage_change: A green shell/build workflow verifies this UI slice, not total phase/domain acceptance or production behavior.

evidence_observations.area: Communication announcement security, lifecycle and atomicity
evidence_observations.finding: The earlier test failure attempted to mock final NotificationService with Mockery. On the later tested head, the full clean-install MySQL workflow passed and CommunicationAnnouncementsTest reported 10 passed (65 assertions). PR #70 remains open.
evidence_observations.reason_no_percentage_change: The targeted feature suite passes, but the complete Communication domain acceptance and PR integration are not yet closed.

evidence_observations.area: Calendar Core tenant isolation, MySQL clean install and concurrency
evidence_observations.finding: The earlier failures shared a missing tenant_id insert error. The subsequent commit passed the Calendar security/concurrency tests, empty-MySQL migrations, repeat migrations, fresh migration/seed, and remaining clean-install gates. The PR then advanced by one commit changing CalendarEvent guarded-write behavior; the exact-current-head run is still in progress and must pass before Calendar is promoted.
evidence_observations.reason_no_percentage_change: The current PR head has not completed its exact-head MySQL verification.

scoring_guidance.verified: Implemented and supported by current exact-head tests or reproducible operational evidence.
scoring_guidance.partial: Implemented in part, or evidence covers only part of the acceptance criteria.
scoring_guidance.missing: Not implemented or no qualifying implementation evidence.
scoring_guidance.unknown: Cannot be determined from accessible repository evidence.
scoring_guidance.owner_update_required: Change phase/domain percentages only through an Owner-reviewed change to this file, with evidence notes. Nightly automation must not promote scores based solely on commit counts or PR activity.
